scope: Concepts only; no runtime or route changes.

variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: polished landscape interactive portfolio concept board, not implementation. Create one landscape 16:9 board with a large main isometric scene occupying upper 72%, and three smaller clean storyboard frames along the bottom showing bridge forming, traveler crossing, bridge withdrawing. Reference image 1 is the actual current implementation and MUST govern the simple blocky geometry, limited palette, coarse nearest-neighbor pixel edges, small island scale, quiet flat faces. Reference image 2 is only a broader island composition reference; do not copy its extra ornate architecture or old bicycle. Existing theme: solid deep charcoal teal background #222e32, muted grey green stone slabs, subdued ivory traveler and warm ochre accents. Original white tall hat traveler with short ivory cloak and dark face. Not glossy, not reflective, no sea, no fog, no bloom, no lens effects, no neon beam bridge. The main scene shows the Bot island on left with cute cube robot, and desktop gadget island on right with small monitor and phone; they are already visually close, now a SHORT direct bridge spans the empty gap instead of the existing long route via distant hubs. Keep both complete islands visible and the gap legible. Grey green square stone bridge segments must physically form a safe continuous WALKABLE bridge ahead of the traveler and retract/disappear only behind him. No levitation or jumping by the traveler. A middle crossing frame must clearly show at least 3 fully aligned blocks immediately under and ahead of feet, and a few blocks lower in the void at each growing/retracting end. Small secondary faint silhouettes of the existing route can appear at top corners to explain shortcut but do not clutter. Use only small English pixel captions: large top-left variant identifier and title, tiny bottom frame captions "RISE", "CROSS", "VANISH"; optional small island labels "Bot", "Desktop". No extra UI labels or large explanatory paragraphs. This design language also needs to work for Rally ↔ Cloud Gaming (race track to Pong monitor) and Accelerator ↔ iShowFX (globe to photo printer), no need to draw all pairs in this board. Each block top is clear and calm, limited 3-tone shading, height variation only in emerging/retracting blocks.
Text (verbatim): A / RISING STONES
Bridge animation A: straight squared grey green chunky stone tiles RISE VERTICALLY from darkness below, one at a time, in a measured domino wave. No rotation. Main view shows rear tiles descending and gently fading, middle tiles firmly aligned at walking height, forward tiles in several distinct heights stepping upward into alignment. Thin warm gold edge only at the leading tile. Tiny 2-3 ivory square motes at ends. Most restrained, architectural, grounded and visually close to the actual live screenshot.
variants.correction: Replace mistaken PhotoMuseum wall on destination island with a Desktop Gadgets monitor, keyboard and phone, preserving the entire bridge storyboard.

Text (verbatim): B / TURNING SLABS
Bridge animation B: thick rectangular stone slabs rise out of the void, then each rotates 90 degrees around its own crosswise hinge before docking flat. Main view clearly shows a few upright emerging slabs below front edge and one half rotated slab, followed by a safe flat aligned walkway under traveler. Strong geometric puzzle mechanism quality. Remain coarse simple block art.

Text (verbatim): C / PIXEL WEAVE
Bridge animation C: quiet small ivory and grey green square voxel fragments rise vertically from void and fuse into thick stone blocks. Main view shows 2-3 forming blocks ahead at different heights, safe solid squared grey green walkway under traveler, then behind him 2 blocks progressively break into a small restrained number of voxel cubes that sink downward and dissolve into transparency. Gold seams briefly run across top only during assembly. No starry particle explosion, no glowing transparent bridge; full weight bearing segments are ordinary matte grey green stone. Airy magical pixel materialization rather than mechanical rotation.

sharedBehavior: Bidirectional shortcuts participate in shortest-path selection.
Bridge blocks rise only when a route actually uses the shortcut.
Keep aligned blocks under and ahead of the traveler; withdraw passed blocks sequentially.
Retargeting or cancellation must keep a safe support under the traveler.
All three concepts depict Bot to Desktop for comparison; existing island layout and models are preserved in implementation.
